title: Booking.com prices
description: Three row types share one dataset: hotel (one property with its price for the stay, charged when priced), room (one room and rate combination, charged, only with includeRooms) and status (per destination or property, free).

dataset.title: Booking.com prices
dataset.description: One row per property with the stay total and nightly rate, optional room-rate rows, and status rows. Charged rows are billed as delivered; unpriced properties and status rows are always free.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: One JSON record with the counts this run delivered and charged, its filtered and duplicate tallies, and its HTTP stats.
